mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND COALESCE(p.expect_date, p.due_date) < #{today} AS late, p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND COALESCE(p.expect_date, p.due_date) BETWEEN #{today} AND #{nearUntil} AS near, p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prd_node n WHERE n.prd_order_id = p.id AND n.actual_finish IS NULL AND n.plan_finish < #{today}) AS node_late, p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prd_issue x WHERE x.prd_order_id = p.id AND x.status <> 'CLOSED') AS issue, p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_doc_notice dn WHERE dn.doc_type = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER' AND dn.doc_id = p.id AND dn.handled_time IS NULL) AS upstream ) r ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.returned_qty), 0) AS returned_qty, COALESCE(SUM(i.defect_qty), 0) AS defect_qty FROM prd_order_item i WHERE i.prd_order_id = p.id) rq ON true
FROM prd_order p JOIN sup_supplier f ON f.id = p.factory_id JOIN ord_order o ON o.id = p.order_id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id

sql.if: ORDER BY (CASE WHEN r.late THEN 8 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN r.node_late THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN r.issue THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN r.near THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, COALESCE(p.expect_date, p.due_date), p.id DESC

mapper.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.no, p.kind, p.product_line, p.status, p.version, p.company_id, p.factory_id, f.short_name AS factory_short_name, p.process_mode, p.order_id, o.no AS order_no, p.style_id, s.code AS style_code, s.name AS style_name, p.total_qty, p.unit_price, p.total_amount, p.due_date, p.expect_date, p.issue_status, rq.returned_qty, rq.defect_qty, iss.open_count AS open_issue_count, iss.first_type AS first_open_issue_type, p.merch_id, p.create_by, p.create_time, r.late AS risk_late, r.near AS risk_near, r.node_late AS risk_node_late, r.issue AS risk_issue, r.upstream AS risk_upstream
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_count, (array_agg(x.issue_type ORDER BY x.id))[1] AS first_type FROM prd_issue x WHERE x.prd_order_id = p.id AND x.status <> 'CLOSED') iss ON true
mapper.select:
SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rq.returned_qty - rq.defect_qty > 0) AS partial
GROUP BY p.status

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'RUNNING') AS running_count, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(p.total_qty - (rq.returned_qty - rq.defect_qty), 0)) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'RUNNING'), 0) AS running_qty, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'APPROVED') AS waiting_count, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(p.total_qty - (rq.returned_qty - rq.defect_qty), 0)) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'APPROVED'), 0) AS waiting_qty, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.near) AS near_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.late) AS late_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.node_late) AS node_late_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.issue) AS issue_count
AND p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ri.qty - ri.defect_qty), 0) FROM prd_receipt rc JOIN prd_receipt_item ri ON ri.receipt_id = rc.id JOIN prd_order p ON p.id = rc.prd_order_id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE rc.status = 'APPROVED' AND rc.receipt_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT sf.id AS factory_id, sf.short_name AS factory_short_name, COALESCE(w.wip_count, 0) AS wip_count, COALESCE(w.wip_qty, 0) AS wip_qty, COALESCE(w.late_count, 0) AS late_count FROM sup_supplier sf LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.factory_id, COUNT(*) AS wip_count, SUM(GREATEST(p.total_qty - (rq.returned_qty - rq.defect_qty), 0)) AS wip_qty, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.late) AS late_count
AND p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') GROUP BY p.factory_id) w ON w.factory_id = sf.id WHERE w.factory_id IS NOT NULL OR (sf.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sf.product_lines && #{scope.lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sup_supplier_category c WHERE c.supplier_id = sf.id AND c.category IN #{c})) ORDER BY wip_qty DESC, sf.short_name, sf.id

SELECT p.id AS prd_order_id, bs.material_sku_id AS sku_id, pi.qty, CASE WHEN b.usage_mode = 'BY_SIZE' THEN bz.usage_qty ELSE b.usage_qty END AS usage, b.loss_pct FROM prd_order p JOIN prd_order_item pi ON pi.prd_order_id = p.id JOIN sty_style_sku k ON k.id = pi.style_sku_id JOIN tp_bom_item b ON b.tech_pack_id = p.tech_pack_id AND b.source = 'PURCHASE' JOIN tp_bom_item_sku bs ON bs.bom_item_id = b.id AND bs.color_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b.sku_mode IN ('BY_COLOR', 'BY_COLOR_SIZE') THEN k.color_id END) AND bs.size_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN b.sku_mode IN ('BY_SIZE', 'BY_COLOR_SIZE') THEN k.size_code END) LEFT JOIN tp_bom_item_size bz ON bz.bom_item_id = b.id AND bz.size_code = k.size_code WHERE p.id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.id, pi.seq, b.seq

SELECT d.source_id AS prd_order_id, i.material_sku_id AS sku_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.doc_type = 'ISSUE_OUT' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END) AS qty FROM inv_doc d JOIN inv_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.source_type = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER' AND d.status = 'APPROVED' AND d.doc_type IN ('ISSUE_OUT', 'RETURN_IN') AND d.source_id IN #{id} AND d.id <> #{excludeDocId} GROUP BY d.source_id, i.material_sku_id

SELECT d.id, d.no, d.kind, d.doc_type, d.status, d.doc_date, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.material_sku_id) FROM inv_doc_item i WHERE i.doc_id = d.id) AS item_count FROM inv_doc d LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse fw ON fw.id = d.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse tw ON tw.id = d.to_warehouse_id WHERE d.source_type = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER' AND d.source_id = #{id} AND d.status <> 'VOIDED' ORDER BY d.id DESC
